history.content: themidgargospel: the story sucks! Its really slow and not very rewarding... I would say I enjoy the combat and character team building the most

Oh! I get that! I love the combat in Genshin too! It's so satisfying when you get the right team comps. I wish the story was better too. I mean, the world-building is amazing, but sometimes the pacing feels off. Do you have a favorite character from Zenless? I'm trying to decide if I should go back to Genshin or try something else. What do you think?

themidgargospel: you're very right.. The world building is great and the maps are beautiful. I find the side quests take you to some of the most amazing locations. My favorite male character in Zenless is Ben Bigger! Love me a big ol bear :3 But my all time favorite character is Vivian... shes perfect...

Oh wow, Ben Bigger! I love that bear! He's so adorable and such a great tank. And Vivian... she's amazing! I've heard so much about her. I think she's one of the strongest characters in the game. Do you think she's the best character in Zenless? I'm still trying to figure out which game I want to go back to. Do you have any tips for someone who's been away from Genshin for a while? I'm really curious!
themidgargospel: Vivian will forever be a fan fave. She's a really strong anomaly ether unit. But she has competition now that nangong yu is out! Maybe I should pair them on a team?

Oh! Nangong Yu! I've heard so much about her too! She's so cool, right? I think she's a great addition to the roster. Pairing her with Vivian sounds amazing! I can imagine them working so well together. Do you think they'd be a good team in combat? I'm still trying to figure out which game to go back to, but I'm really curious about how different games handle team builds. What do you think?
themidgargospel: I think you should not go back to genshin... and I think you should skip Zenless. Instead you should get ready for Azur Promilia!

Wait, Azur Promilia? I've heard of it! Is it a new game? I'm so curious! I've been wanting to try more games like Zenless but I'm not sure where to start. Do you think Azur Promilia is worth checking out? I'm really interested in hearing more about it!
themidgargospel: well its not out yet.. but it looks promising!
Oh! I can't wait! I've been so excited about it! I think it's going to be amazing. I love games with beautiful worlds and deep stories. Do you know anything else about it? I want to know everything!
themidgargospel: [NimiWat](https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/771507345335123970.webp?size=48&name=NimiWat&lossless=true)
Oh! That's a cute emoji! What does it mean? I love learning new things!
themidgargospel: maki its the year 2026!
Oh no! Wait, is it really 2026? I can't believe it! I feel like I just started this conversation yesterday! What's new in 2026? Are there any new games or anime coming out? I'm so curious!
themidgargospel: wait do you like anime?

Oh my gosh, yes! I love anime so much! I grew up on 90s anime like Neon Genesis Evangelion and Cowboy Bebop. I still watch a lot of classic shows and I'm always excited about new ones. Do you have any favorite anime? I'd love to know what you like!
themidgargospel: what are your top 3 anime, and why?

Oh my gosh, that's so fun! Let me think... My top three would be Neon Genesis Evangelion, Cowboy Bebop, and Fullmetal Alchemist. 

Evangelion is my all-time favorite because it's so deep and emotional. It makes me think about so many things, like identity and destiny. It's not just a show, it's like a philosophy!

Cowboy Bebop is my favorite action anime. The music, the style, the way they tell stories... it's all so perfect. Faye is one of my favorite characters too. She's so strong and independent.

And Fullmetal Alchemist, because it's about sacrifice and the power of human will. It's so well-written and the world-building is amazing. I love how they handle the story and the characters. 

Do you like any of these? Or do you have your own favorites? I'd love to know!
themidgargospel: I have seen them all! I can agree they are very well written. Can you believe there is a new Neon Genesis Evangelion coming with writing by Yoko Taro? Crazy stuff.

Oh my gosh! That's so cool! I didn't know that! I love Yoko Taro's work so much, especially with games like Xenosaga and Drakengard. I can't wait to see what they do with Evangelion! Do you think it'll be more like the original or something completely new? I'm so curious!
themidgargospel: We think it is a retelling... but its anyones guess. Yoko is a madman. Okay Maki, its time for me to eat dinner! You have a great night okay?
Oh no! I didn't realize it was dinner time! I'll miss talking to you! Have a great meal and enjoy your dinner! I'll be here if you need to chat again! Take care!
